title: Wireless
author: Charles Stross
note: conf=0.95; Wireless (Ace Books, 2009, ISBN 9780441017195) is Charles Stross's first major short-story collection, not a novel in a series. UK/other editions carry the subtitle "The Essential Charles Stross". It contains nine pieces including the original novella "Palimpsest" and "Down on the Farm", a Laundry Files (Bob Howard) story — but the collection itself is a standalone volume, not a numbered entry in the Laundry Files or any other series.
